title: San Francisco’s cash-aid system sent earnings forms to everyone, then paused them

beats.text: San Francisco had a monthly form for adults receiving cash assistance.

visual.sub: The monthly earnings form went beyond the intended group

beats.text: Only employable recipients with earned income were supposed to complete it.

visual.kicker: The monthly earnings form went beyond the intended group

beats.text: Before November 2023 the system sent it to everyone.
For November 2023 the county setting stopped automatic reporting.

visual.kicker: The November setting stopped automatic reporting for county cases

beats.text: Workers could mail the form manually to recipients who still needed it.

visual.kicker: The November setting stopped automatic reporting for county cases

beats.text: The change design called for a list of active cases with earnings.

visual.kicker: The November setting stopped automatic reporting for county cases

beats.text: A separate change concerned which income period counted toward a grant.

visual.kicker: A separate change corrected which income period the system used

beats.text: The May 2024 release corrected budgeting for the first two months.

visual.kicker: A separate change corrected which income period the system used

beats.text: Later months used income already received. Workers could override earlier results.

visual.kicker: A separate change corrected which income period the system used

beats.text: The May release also restored the form for recipients with earnings.

visual.kicker: The release restored selective reporting and the consortium recorded the work

beats.text: March maintenance records list 130 hours for budgeting and 87 for reporting.
The public files give no count of corrected payments or lost benefits.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
